quote: The documentation describes a lexical, filename, sketch and full-passage verification cascade; it calls its scores calibrated and claims jegrep benchmark parity. Those two statements are upstream claims to test, not measurements of llame.

The source caps names at128, file reads at20, windows per file at24, UTF-8 window bytes at8192, sketches at384, verified passages globally at40, sketch cutoff at0.45 and hit threshold at0.20. Two lexical leaders are always admitted to content reads. Each phase drains before the next with at most16 judgment requests in flight. Failed sketches become unknown scores of1 but still compete under the top40 cap; failed verification adds no ranges.

The native grep call passes root, keywords, case-insensitivity, hidden/gitignore and timeout but not the eligible-file deny lists. IDF is clamp(log((filesScanned+1)/(df+1)),0.5,6). File score sums weight*(2*pathSubstringMatch+log1p(nonoverlapping occurrences on matched lines)).

Windows preserve line coordinates but clip an oversized single line rather than splitting it into more windows. If every window score is zero, selection spreads through the file; otherwise it keeps the best lexical windows. Sketches trim selected verbatim lines, favor call-like lines by0.1, cap a selected line at180 bytes, then restore source order. Merge touches only contiguous/overlapping positive ranges and takes maximum probability, retaining the first snippet.

readText reads up to maxBytes+1, checks for NUL only in the first8192 bytes, trims truncated data to its last complete newline when any exists, otherwise retains a clipped long line, and decodes with TextDecoder. Bounded reads have no signal parameter. UTF-8 clipBytes and takeChars preserve code points; default TextDecoder can replace an incomplete raw byte prefix.

Each request has one shared JSON state and one independent noul question per candidate. Filename state carries criteria, format, project, search, task and tree. Sketch state carries criteria, files, passages and search. Verification state carries criteria, file, passages and search; its passage strings have generated line tags removed. Verification criteria reject mere mentions/calls/imports/tests/configuration and accept substantive implementation, definition or explanation.

locator: Evaluation endpoint; Question types; Answer types
quote: A request supplies state, model and a map of typed questions. Noul returns a yes probability; Choice selects a named option with a distribution; Score returns a probability-weighted rubric level. Question-map keys are routing identifiers, not inference inputs, so OMP also references candidate tags explicitly inside each question instruction.

locator: Confidence is derived from probabilities; Thresholds scale with risk
quote: Choice/Score confidence derives from the returned probability distribution, and Noul has no separate confidence field. The documentation says thresholds depend on domain and model performance and must be tested on the user workload; a concentrated distribution is not an independent correctness or authorization guarantee.

Pinned unchanged TypeScript, transpiled with installed esbuild and explicit model/native-I/O/auth/timer doubles:151listed paths reduce to128name judgments and20content reads, leaving a late lexical-tie target unseen;80sketches with one failed batch yield40verified and40pruned; total verification outage yields0hits with1error/3requests; a20011-byte single line advertises complete one-line coverage despite hidden tail; a native noul2 passes client type checking but causes6errors/4requests and nofailure messages; text replies parse to0/1.

One ordinary repository exploration returned729listed files,128name judgments,20files read,26logical requests,25Kdisplayed input tokens,0.2585USDreported cost,10.0s wall and35.3s summed API time. The model, endpoint and exact runtime revision are not exposed, so this is not a Jev pricing/latency/calibration benchmark or verified billing.

Query terms preserve quoted phrases, discard stopwords, ASCII numbers and terms shorter than3UTF-8 bytes, then try ing/ed/es/s suffix removal if the remaining JavaScript string length is at least4. Extra keywords bypass those query filters. The cutoff uses UTF-16 units, unlike Rust UTF-8 byte length.

File listing applies build/lock/binary/credential deny lists, excludes empty files, and uses hidden/gitignore-aware native glob. Credential exact names are case-sensitive; extensions are lowercased. These heuristics are not a source authorization or secret-content scanner.

Tool find forces includeHidden:false, maps paths relative to session cwd, special-cases omp:// through temporary materialization, shows up to3ranges, and marks error only when requests>0 and errors===requests; otherwise no hits is useless. It wires journalJudgmentUsage but does not return the resolved judge identity per score.

Backend kind follows API, not provider name. After the first native candidate, only native candidates remain; a session-model fallback can be appended only for an entirely non-native chain and when supplied by the caller. Candidate resolution caches1s, account401/402/403 rejections cool down5min. Local keyword budgets are16tokens or1024for reasoning, not scaled to question count. Native usage wraps one logical call; zero cost triggers catalog pricing and failed calls record zero-token errors.

Available models are filtered by disabled-provider settings and configured credential source/keyless status. This synchronous precheck does not refresh OAuth or test the remote account; per-request key resolution can still fail. It is false to say auto enablement ignores credential configuration entirely.

TypeSafe route /v1/systemone and OpenRouter route /decisions share state/model/questions body. Each request key must exist and match type, but numeric noul ranges are not validated here. Default per-attempt timeout10s, at most3HTTP attempts on transport/408/429/5xx, backoff500/1000ms or Retry-After capped5s. Auth rotation is outside this retry loop.

Text Noul parses the first whole-word yes/true or no/false and returns exactly1or0. Choice/Score produce one-hot probabilities and confidence1. Batched replies require one ID line per answer; missing lines fail parsing. Returned usage is only the successfully parsed completion.

Chat judgment asks for4096output tokens, temperature0 and reasoningdisabled, with2format-correction retries. Corrections force a submit_judgment tool; transient completion retries and attempt usage hooks are distinct from parsing retries. Reasoning suppression may not be obeyed by all backends.

Default budgets and stages match OMP:128names,20files,24windows,8192byte windows,384byte sketches,40full passages, cutoff.45. CLI/environment knobs allow other values. Default filename call uses Lean; sketch wording matches OMP; verification calls compact passage_request with true. Local grep precedes full tree expansion, and file reads are sequential here rather than OMP Promise.all.

Default QFmt is Lean, whose file question wording matches OMP find-name-question.md. Full and LeanRef are explicit environment alternatives, not evidence that default questions differ. The Rust state uses sorted JSON maps.
Compact passage_request strips generated line tags and uses the same passage criteria and question wording as OMP. Noncompact request shape exists but cascade passes compact=true.

Rust stem accepts suffix removal when base.len()>=4, counting UTF-8 bytes. Thus étés can stem to été (5bytes), while OMP rejects a3-UTF16-unit base. This is a concrete default-path difference, unlike mere use of a different template implementation.

Standalone client prefers OpenRouter, can load keys from environment/~/.env and fail over to TypeSafe even when a hosted preference is explicit. Local endpoint sends no auth and adds no hosted fallback. HTTP timeout is120s per ureq request; retry-enabled sends allow6retries; with two providers the first send skips those retries and the fallback enables them. Optional Noul chunking has2physical requests in flight per logical call.

Sixteen registered strategy names cover baseline, beam, sniff, deep, paged variants, inline variants, budget, window, hybrid-window and cascade. Passage strategies do not use the whole-file bytes/ranges/min-hits knobs. This is a research CLI with alternatives; OMP ports one selected strategy.

Reported30query comparison:49/49files and93/94regions; estimated cost0.145097versus0.232162USD (37.5%less). Kubernetes line coverage94.8%versus99.7% and one region missed. Positive-only labels, one repeat per variant, unflushed OS cache and mutable jev-latest prevent calibration, general precision or stable latency claims. CPython9.9%development and10.9%final-parent generated-bytecode coverage refer to distinct runs.

File recall checks labeled paths; region recall credits any overlap among the top3returned ranges; annotated-line recall measures actual coverage. Unlabeled extra hits are unknown unless labels are exhaustive. Runs have explicit failure/incomplete-cost status, and quality aggregates do not establish probability calibration.

Unchanged scorer on synthetic output yields100%file/region recall with1%line recall. An extra unlabelled path produces precision:null, not a false positive; a fourth lower-score gold range is excluded by default top3. Inventory found40positive query cases and no referenced comparison/cascade JSON or raw-run directories. Default OMP caps permit39logical judgment calls at most, not a bound on physical retries.

Chat retrieval already fuses FTS/trigram/vector ranks, reauthorizes canonical source text, returns at most one bounded passage per Chat, and withholds ranking scores and omission reasons. A new judged reranker is a proposed contract change, not transparent replacement of the shared ordering.

Explicit Space access resolves by trusted userId; current live search delegates to the bounded filesystem adapter and returns locators/excerpts with completeness warnings. Existing search is a candidate-source seam, not a universal corpus or snapshot identity.

Tools must survive ID validation, exact allowlisting, trusted classification/host-capability rules, collision handling and schema admission. Semantic hints must consume admitted descriptions and cannot grant invocation permissions.

Operator sources publish a catalog. Manual-only versus proactively eligible controls are deterministic. Explicit mentions still require read admission; skill loading grants no permissions and cannot read another owner Knowledge. Suggestions must not silently activate manual-only packages.

Current Projects group one owner Chats and do not grant Knowledge, tools or filesystem Workspaces. Workspace/Sandbox/Node and broader artifacts are future capabilities, not current isolation boundaries.

Current model clients dispatch by explicit provider type: OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, Codex and OpenCode Go. No native TypeSafe/System One transport is present. A TypeSafe endpoint is not an OpenAI-compatible baseUrl substitution.

A generated answer from a selected source and a broader read-only investigator are distinct proposed contracts. Helper economics compare actual post-projection context; a source already retained by both alternatives is common cost. Real transcript quality/cost/latency measurement remains open.

jegrep is a standalone Rust semantic search CLI over a live source tree with no persistent semantic index. Cascade is default, other strategies expose different exploration policies, CLI/environment knobs and local System One-shaped endpoints are supported. README price/latency language is upstream description, not this study benchmark.

OMP uses typed judgment outside file search to classify reasoning effort, with candidate-specific local versus richer labels and a host clamp to model-supported/configured effort. This demonstrates a bounded control hint rather than giving a model authority over arbitrary actions.

locator: visible-message text and owner authorization requirements
quote: Conversation reads derive owner authority from trusted Run identity and expose eligible visible user/assistant text, not tool parts, reasoning, attachments or arbitrary Run logs. A future log finder requires its own admitted source projection.

Current Run orchestration persists model/tool lifecycle and usage, prepares an attempt-local admitted catalog and keeps invocation permission gates. This does not itself establish a durable generic helper-judge invocation receipt, independent budget or coverage ledger.
Jev ingests the `state` once and evaluates every question against it in parallel.

The scorer sorts each file ranges by descending probability and keeps ranges[:top_ranges], default3. Both region recall (any overlap) and annotated-line recall use that same selected prediction set. Lower line recall can reflect output-range selection as well as unread/unverified source; it is not a measurement of all judged bytes. Unlabelled extra paths are unknown unless labels are exhaustive.

Candidates are mapped from eligible entries, so rejected grep paths do not enter model state. Undefined filename scores sort as0 except for the two forced lexical leaders; undefined sketch scores sort as1 under the global40passage cap. Files are read once into FilePlan.passages; sketches and verification reuse those in-memory strings. Drift can occur between initial listing/grep and that read, or a later caller read, not through a sketch-to-verification re-read.
